description.value: Kwao Thai Restaurant is a family-run authentic Thai restaurant in Esquimalt, just outside Victoria. The name 'Kwao' means rice in Thai, and the menu centres on traditional dishes — curries, stir-fries, soups, and noodles — with customizable spice levels from mild to Thai hot. Cyclists will find a welcoming neighbourhood spot offering both dine-in and takeout, with explicit support for vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-friendly diets.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is accessible and detailed: takeout is explicitly offered ('Take Out and DINE-IN'), vegetarian and vegan options are confirmed ('Vegetarian & Vegan are available'), and the About page notes gluten-free compatibility of rice dishes. No bike parking, water refill, or washroom information appears on the website or in OSM tags. A postal code discrepancy exists: OSM has V9A 3P1 while the website consistently shows V9A 3P2 across all pages.
concerns: Postal code discrepancy: OSM has V9A 3P1; website consistently shows V9A 3P2 across all pages — website value used in address field.
OSM addr:city is 'Esquimalt' (the correct municipality) but website lists 'Victoria, BC' as the city — minor civic boundary issue, Esquimalt retained as authoritative.

Website footer credits '© 2023 by Luna Tapas. Proudly created with Wix.com' — appears to be a Wix template originally built for a different business (Luna Tapas); content throughout is clearly for Kwao Thai Restaurant, so not a business-identity concern, but worth noting.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: An active, family-run restaurant with confirmed takeout service and explicit vegetarian/vegan/GF options makes it a practical refuelling stop for touring cyclists on the Esquimalt corridor near Victoria. Bike-specific amenities are unconfirmed but absence of evidence does not preclude inclusion for a food listing.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Website front page states 'Vegetarian & Vegan are available'; About page notes rice dishes are 'naturally good for gluten-free diets' and advises vegans to request fish sauce be omitted
